_comment: Sold-mark CATALOG for tools/price-engine/sold-marks.mjs (nightly, GitHub Action price-snapshot). Every entry is a SportsCardsPro/PriceCharting item path + the condition whose dated sales make its mark. src: site:* = cards the site tracks (Bangers board, set-index baskets); catalog = cards Vault users hold, matched to a Vault card by h, an FNV-1a hash of the lowercased COMC card string (the string itself is never published). Built 2026-09-24 by the CoS; re-resolve with tools/price-engine/universe-pokemon.mjs and the SCP console matcher when an index reconstitutes or the catalog grows. Never add a card whose path was not verified by card number + name.
